name: bizplug-education
description: The education & schools plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book campus visits and info sessions. It works from the business's own published profile, covering admissions, programs, calendars and tuition, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
